| Account ID | Open Date | Loan ID | Approved Amount | Duration (months) |
|-------------|-----------|---------|----------------|-------------------|
| 10451 | 1993-08-29 | 7142 | 482,940 | 60 |

**Final Answer:** Account 10451 (opened on 1993-08-29) has the highest approved loan amount of 482,940 with a duration of 60 months.

**Evidence SQL:**
```sql
SELECT a.account_id, a.date as open_date, l.loan_id, l.amount, l.duration FROM account a JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id WHERE l.duration > 12 AND a.date LIKE '1993%' AND l.amount = (SELECT MAX(l2.amount) FROM account a2 JOIN loan l2 ON a2.account_id = l2.account_id WHERE l2.duration > 12 AND a2.date LIKE '1993%')
```
